note: a plain-Python model of the documented behaviour (cx.sh, no GNU Radio) gives 34.
note: the block is a decimating FIR filter after the magnitude stage; GNU Radio starts it from zero history, so it gives (input count)/(Audio Decimation) items, and the input count is a whole multiple of the decimation, so no remainder is left at the end.
note: every parameter of the GRC block is stated (with Audio Pass and Audio Stop), the input count and value are stated, and the question asks for the total count; I found no second reading.
note: verdict approve: a careful reader reaches this value from the wording alone.

question: In GNU Radio 3.10, take the g721 Audio Decoder block (`vocoder_g721_decode_bs`) with its default settings. Its input receives 107 byte items, every item 0, and then the input ends. How many short items does it produce in total?
evidence: GNU Radio 3.10.12 run (twice, identical): 107; the reference model of the block's documented behaviour agrees
reviewer_1_note:
note: blind value 107 from my GNU Radio 3.10.12 run: vector source(s) with the stated input -> the block, built with its GRC make template -> vector sink(s).
note: the decoder outputs one short per input byte (one 4-bit code per byte), so 107 bytes give 107 shorts.
note: a reader who assumed two packed 4-bit codes per byte would answer 214. The block name (bs: byte in, short out) and the matching encoder g721_encode_sb (one byte per short) point to one code per byte; I take this as the reading a GNU Radio user takes.
reviewer_2_note:
note: blind value 107: GNU Radio 3.10.12 ran vocoder.g721_decode_bs() on the stated input; two runs gave identical output (q.sh).
note: a plain-Python model of the documented behaviour (cx.sh, no GNU Radio) gives 107.
note: the G.721 decoder takes one 4-bit code per input byte and gives one short per byte: 107.
note: the docstring does not say how codes sit in the bytes; a reader who assumed two codes packed per byte would answer 214. The GRC block has no rate or vector parameter, so a GNU Radio user expects one output per input; I approve and record the other reading.
note: verdict approve: a careful reader reaches this value from the wording alone.
